Alerts.NotProvisioned: This company's database isn't created yet

Dashboard.Title: Dashboard
Dashboard.Attention: Needs attention (expiring within {days} days, expired, or being set up)

Companies.LocksHint: Locked permissions don't work for any user in this company, including the system admin. Use the general list from the panel settings, or a list just for this company
Companies.LocksGlobal: Same as the general list ({n} permissions)
Companies.LocksCustom: A list just for this company
Companies.Title: Companies
Companies.Search: Search by name, code, phone or VAT no.
Companies.Created: Company saved, but its database wasn't created
Companies.PendingNote: The company's database isn't created yet. Press “Create database” when you're ready (database, tables, main branch and company admin). If an earlier attempt failed, it will be rebuilt from scratch.
Companies.ChangePasswordNote: The admin will be asked to change this password on first sign-in.
Companies.DbNameHint: Suggested automatically and editable. Can't change after creation.
Companies.SupportSoon: Support sign-in and admin password reset will work after the ERP is connected to the panel.
Companies.SuspendConfirm: Suspend the company? Its staff won't be able to sign in.
Companies.CancelConfirm: Cancel the company permanently? (data is not deleted)
Companies.CreatedReady: Company ready: database, tables and admin created
Companies.ReadyNote: Everything is done: database, tables, main branch and company admin. Print the sheet and hand it to the client.
Companies.ProvisionFailedNote: The company was saved but database setup failed. Fix the cause, open the company and press “Create database”.
Companies.ProvisionNowHint: If unchecked: the company is only saved, and you create the database later from the company page with “Create database”.
Companies.CreatedPending: Company saved. Create its database from the company page when you're ready
Companies.SkippedNote: The data is saved and the company is “pending”. Open the company and press “Create database” when you're ready; the link works after that.
Companies.DangerNote: These actions are permanent and can't be undone. If the company just didn't renew, use “Suspend” or “Cancel” in the Subscription tab instead.
Companies.DropDbHint: Deletes the company's database with all its data (invoices, items, users...) and its MySQL user. The company stays in the panel, and you can create a new empty database later.
Companies.DropDbWarn: Everything in database {db} will be permanently deleted. Take a backup first if you need the data.
Companies.DeleteCompanyHint: Removes the company from the panel completely (its data and subscription history). For tests or companies created by mistake.
Companies.DeleteWarn: The company will be permanently removed from the panel and its code will stop working.
Companies.TypeCode: Type the company code ({code}) to confirm
Companies.NewAdminPasswordHint: The old admin password isn't saved (the database was deleted before). Enter a new password for the company admin ({user}).
Companies.PlanPriceHint: Calculated from the plan price ({price} {period}) for the period; you can edit it
Companies.NoPlanPriceHint: The company has no plan, enter the amount manually
Companies.AmountAutoHint: Calculated from the plan price and period; you can edit it
Companies.SyncDone: Subscription written to the company database
Companies.SyncFailedNote: Saved in the panel, but not written to the company database. Open “Overview” and press “Sync”.
Companies.FeaturesNote: For each feature: “Follow plan” (default), or “On”/“Off” for this company only, without affecting other companies on the same plan. Locked features disappear for the company (even the system admin) and remain for the program owner.
Companies.FeaturesSaved: Features saved and delivered to the company
Companies.ModulesNote: Modules come from the company's activity; you can enable or disable a module for this company only
Companies.ModulesNoActivity: No activity is set for this company; only modules enabled here are active
Companies.InfoSyncFailed: Saved in the panel, but the company data inside the app could not be updated

Plans.Title: Plans
Plans.Name: Plan
Plans.FeaturesHint: Unchecked features are locked for companies on this plan (even the system admin) and stay available to the program owner only. Changes here reach all companies on the plan automatically.

Activities.Title: Activities
Activities.Subtitle: A company's activity sets its sign-in screen look
Activities.Name: Activity
Activities.ImageHint: An image representing the activity, shown on the login screen of companies under it (PNG, JPG or WEBP, up to 2MB)
Activities.InUseHint: Can't be deleted because companies use it; deactivate it instead
Activities.ModulesHint: Extra screens and features shown to companies of this activity. Changes apply to all its companies
Activities.StaffTitleHint: Shown on invoices, POS and the commissions report (technicians module)
Activities.CompaniesCount: {n, plural, =0 {No companies} one {1 company} other {# companies}}

Roles.Title: Roles & permissions
Roles.Subtitle: Permissions of panel staff (the owner has everything)
Roles.Name: Role

Perm.paymentTemplates_manage: Manage and apply payment method templates
Perm.salesChannels_manage: Manage delivery apps and enable them for companies

Settings.ClientLocksHint: Permissions selected here don't work for any user in client companies, including their system admin, and don't appear in their roles screen. Only the program owner can do them from his account inside the company. Saving applies to all companies right away; a company can be given an exception from its page
Settings.Title: Settings
Settings.SecretKeyHint: Set PANEL_SECRET_KEY in .env (32+ characters) and restart the panel. Companies can't be created without it.
Settings.readonlyDaysHint: After grace: view and print only
Settings.MigrationsHint: Set ERP_MIGRATIONS_DIR in .env to the main program's prisma\migrations folder and restart the panel. Companies can't be created without it.
Settings.VendorHint: Shown to all customers: “Powered by ...” on the login screen and menu footer, the “Contact us” page and subscription messages. Changes reach all companies automatically.
Settings.VendorSaved: Saved, and being written to all companies
Settings.vendorLogoHint: Small logo shown next to “Powered by” (transparent PNG works best)
Settings.SyncFailedCount: Could not apply to {n} companies; check their database connections and save again

Updates.Title: Company database updates
Updates.Subtitle: Choose which companies to update, and up to which update
Updates.Note: Updates apply in order: you can stop at any update, but you can't skip one and apply the ones after it. A company that isn't updated may see new program screens fail until it's updated.

RoleTemplates.AppliedSkipped: Applied to {n} companies; {skipped} customized roles were kept unchanged
RoleTemplates.ModeKeep: Update matching roles, keep customized ones
RoleTemplates.ModeKeepHint: Roles customized for a company stay as they are; the rest get the latest template
RoleTemplates.ModeAllHint: Every role goes back to its template; company customizations are removed
RoleTemplates.ConfirmAll: Any customizations to fixed roles in the selected companies will be removed and the roles reset to their templates.
RoleTemplates.ResetConfirm: Reset this role in this company to the template permissions?
RoleTemplates.Title: Role templates
RoleTemplates.Subtitle: Fixed roles delivered to companies (cashier, accountant...)
RoleTemplates.Note: New companies get these templates automatically with “Create database”. Later changes are delivered only when you press “Apply to companies” and choose companies. At the customer these roles are locked: they can only assign them to users.
RoleTemplates.Name: Role
RoleTemplates.ImportHint: Choose a database that has roles (like your main one). Regular roles with their permissions are imported as templates: existing names are updated, new ones added. The system admin and owner roles are skipped.
RoleTemplates.ApplyHint: All templates (names, permissions and status) will be delivered to the companies you choose as fixed roles.

Backups.Title: Database backups
Backups.Subtitle: Back up one or more company databases, or all of them
Backups.Note: These are backups you make from the panel, one file per company. Each company's automatic backup stays inside the program, on its own schedule and folder.
Backups.Slow: May take a while for large databases
Backups.PanelNote: A copy of the control panel database itself (companies, plans, activities, templates, staff). Keep PANEL_SECRET_KEY safe: it is required to decrypt the companies' database credentials.
Backups.UploadNote: Choose the company (or the panel database), then upload a .sql file from your device. It will appear in the files list to restore from.
Backups.Uploaded: File uploaded; restore it from the files list
Backups.MigrateFailed: Could not apply missing updates; run database updates for this company
Backups.ZatcaGap: ZATCA sequence preserved: {n} invoices were sent after this backup
Backups.PanelRestoredNote: If the backup is old, you may need to restart the panel
Backups.PanelRestoreWarn: The whole panel database will be replaced with this backup
Backups.RestoreWarn: All of this company's data will be replaced with this backup
Backups.RestoreStep1: A safety copy of the current state is made first and restored automatically if anything fails
Backups.RestoreStep2: Subscription data is not affected, and the ZATCA invoice sequence never goes back
Backups.RestoreStep3: Older backups get the missing updates automatically; newer ones are rejected
Backups.RestoreStep4: All company users are signed out
Backups.RestoreStep5: Preferably run it outside working hours

PaymentTemplates.Title: Payment method templates
PaymentTemplates.Subtitle: Fixed payment methods applied to companies (cash, card, transfer...)
PaymentTemplates.Note: New companies get these methods automatically when their database is created. Later changes apply only when you click “Apply to companies” and choose companies. These methods are locked for the company; it can only enable or disable them. The status here is the initial status when the method is first added to a company and doesn't change it afterwards.
PaymentTemplates.Name: Payment method
PaymentTemplates.SortOrderHint: Display order on the payment screen (lowest first)
PaymentTemplates.RequiresReferenceHint: Asks the cashier for the transaction number (card slip or transfer number)
PaymentTemplates.StatusHint: Status when first added to a company
PaymentTemplates.ImportHint: Choose a database that has payment methods (like your main database). They are imported as templates: existing names are updated and new ones added.
PaymentTemplates.ApplyHint: All methods (names, types, order) will be applied to the selected companies as fixed payment methods. Each company's enabled/disabled status is kept.

SalesChannels.Title: Delivery apps
SalesChannels.Subtitle: Ordering apps (HungerStation, Jahez, Mrsool...) and enabling them for companies
SalesChannels.Note: These values are defaults used when an app is first enabled for a company. Each company has its own values under “Company apps”, written to its database on save. Companies can't edit the app; they only set their item prices in it (an item without a special price sells at its price plus the markup).
SalesChannels.EditNote: The name, order and status apply to every company using the app. The markup and commission only apply to new companies; existing company values don't change.
SalesChannels.Name: App
SalesChannels.MarkupHint: Added to the item price when selling through the app: a percentage of the price or a fixed amount per item. Companies can set a special price for any item
SalesChannels.CommissionHint: The app's commission percentage of net sales, shown in the company reports (sales, commission and net)
SalesChannels.SortOrderHint: Display order on the cashier screen (lowest first)
SalesChannels.StatusHint: Deactivating the app stops it for all companies
SalesChannels.CompanyHint: Choose the company, then enable the apps it needs and set their values. A disabled app stops at the company; its previous prices and reports remain.
SalesChannels.CompanySaved: Saved, {n} apps enabled for the company
SalesChannels.SyncFailed: The change wasn't applied at {n} companies. Update their databases, then save their apps again
